clock_coherence.origin: actual induction arrays and crank trace

m2_answers.actual_arrays_and_trace: Named event and band metrics originate in actual source arrays; event eligibility is bound to trace windows. pressure_accounting and PCM/isolation checks have their stated non-trace origins.
m2_answers.baseline_candidate_trace_window_rate_cha: Package receipts bind each vehicle's formal parent/candidate to one canonical trace SHA and 48 kHz PCM chain; no raw external recording/window exists to prove an external-reference equivalence.
m2_answers.best_failing_candidate: Yes for diagnostics only: run_round2_coordinate_search returns snapshots[-1] as BEST_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY when no qualified snapshot exists. rank_round2_snapshots never calls it qualified.
m2_answers.diagnostic_package_on_failure: Round-2 package builders intentionally serialize transport-valid diagnostic evidence when automatic gates fail, preserving investigation without declaring qualification.
m2_answers.domain_mixing: Source, final-PCM and audition domains are separately labeled. Stage M rejects diagnostic/review/unbound sources as hard-gate evidence.
m2_answers.formal_vs_review_copy: Formal PCM follows frozen_ptr -> edge_fade -> fixed whole-cycle gain -> PCM24. The 1.25x comfort/review copy is post-PCM audition-only.
m2_answers.hard_gate_data_source: The ten REQUIRED_FULL_GATES are caller-supplied metrics: source-array, trace, final-PCM and isolation checks. reference_distance is not among them.
m2_answers.loudness_copy_raw_analysis: No. loudness_matched_audition_signal is forbidden by the comparator and signal-domain matrix for raw band, loudness, and transient analysis.
m2_answers.named_events_actual_stems: Yes. The R2 receipts cite actual named source arrays plus trace alignment; e.g. LFA lfa_shift_exhaust_reengagement, Ferrari shift_recovery_boom, RX-7 blow_off, Supra spool_release and Aventador V12 re-engagement.
m2_answers.reference_distance_hard_gate: No. reference_distance is neither recomputed by candidate_search nor required by REQUIRED_FULL_GATES; it is a post-gate rank input.
